# ArtSwapy (Art Swapy) — Brand Design & Consulting Studio

> ArtSwapy is the independent brand design and consulting practice founded by Swapnil Gathibandhe (Nagpur, India · working worldwide). ArtSwapy partners directly with founders, business owners, and marketing leads to build complete brand systems—from positioning strategy through visual identity, packaging, communications, and digital/physical applications.

- **Official Website:** https://artswapy.com
- **Brand Name Variations:** ArtSwapy, Art Swapy, ArtSwapy Studio
- **Founder & Creative Director:** Swapnil Gathibandhe
- **Headquarters:** Nagpur, Maharashtra, India (Working Worldwide)
- **Direct Contact Email:** swapnilgathibandhe2494@gmail.com
- **Availability:** Available for new branding, identity, and packaging projects

## Core Capabilities (The 5 Branding Pillars)

1. **Strategy (`#services` / `#process` Phase 01):** Brand architecture, competitive whitespace audit, target audience matrix, positioning, and core narrative/voice (1–2 weeks).
2. **Visual Identity (`#services` / `#process` Phase 02):** Primary and responsive logomarks, bespoke typographic systems, color harmony and contrast rules, and comprehensive brand guidelines (2–3 weeks).
3. **Packaging (`#services` / `#process` Phase 03):** Custom structural box die-lines, label hierarchy and typography specifications, specialty finishes (foil, emboss, UV), and print-ready production files (2 weeks).
4. **Communications (`#services` / `#process` Phase 04):** Campaign art direction, editorial print and poster series, social grid and motion design kits, and storytelling toolkits (1–2 weeks).
5. **Applications (`#services` / `#process` Phase 05):** Responsive web UI design systems, environmental and retail signage, stationery and collateral, and digital design tokens (2 weeks).

## Studio Principles

- **01 · Meaning First:** Strategy and positioning before decoration. Every visual decision is anchored in clear business rationale and cultural resonance.
- **02 · Systematic Craft:** Identity systems built to scale with precision—from tactile packaging and print to digital products and motion.
- **03 · Independent Focus:** Direct founder-to-founder collaboration with Swapnil Gathibandhe from day one. No agency bloat, no intermediate layers.

## Selected Brand Case Studies (Concept Showcase)

- [Aaranya — Botanical Skincare (Brand & Packaging)](https://artswapy.com/work/aaranya): A luxury botanical identity and packaging architecture built for ritual and calm.
- [Common Ground — Specialty Coffee Roasters (Identity & Packaging)](https://artswapy.com/work/common-ground): Warm editorial visual system and modular bag packaging for a neighborhood coffee roaster.
- [Good Habit — Functional Wellness Beverage (Strategy, Identity & Can Packaging)](https://artswapy.com/work/good-habit): High-energy typographic identity and retail-ready can architecture for a modern functional beverage.
- [Kavita — Contemporary Publishing House (Editorial Identity & Book Design)](https://artswapy.com/work/kavita): Architectural grid system and literary cover series for an independent publishing house.
- [Dhara — Artisanal Terracotta & Home Objects (Brand Strategy & Tactile Packaging)](https://artswapy.com/work/dhara): Earth-rooted identity, craft provenance storytelling, and sustainable structural packaging.
